info.name: Mews Booking Engine API (Distributor) Account notes Rate groups API

items.docs: Returns all rate groups, filtered by unique identifiers and other filters. Note this operation uses [Pagination](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/guidelines/pagination/) and supports [Portfolio Access Tokens](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/multi-property).
